recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man in a dark suit seated on a wooden stool against a dark, atmospheric, textured studio backdrop. The composition features a large, stylized typographic block in the upper left quadrant and a secondary logo in the lower left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center to the right, balanced by heavy typography on the left.
Dark suit blending into a dark, mottled background for a moody, low-key effect.
High-contrast white lettering against a dark olive and charcoal environment.
coreInvariants: Subject seated on a simple wooden stool.
Mottled, painterly studio backdrop with subtle horizontal lighting gradient.
Tight, condensed typography with rounded terminals.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated on the right third of the frame, full body visible from head to feet.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white display text in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large text, move right to the subject's face, then down the line of the suit to the stool.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space surrounding the subject, particularly on the left and top.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep olive and charcoal grey (background and suit).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the text and the dark environment.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower-case 'a' with a large counter and short ascender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed sans-serif for impact paired with a delicate script for brand identity.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the condensed, bold, and rounded feel of the display text.
Matches the extreme verticality and tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio portrait of a man in a 1960s dark suit and tie, seated on a simple wooden stool. The background is a dark, mottled olive-grey textured wall with a subtle light source from the left. The man is positioned on the right side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, ultra-condensed rounded sans-serif text in the upper left corner, stacked vertically. Add a small cursive script logo in the bottom left corner. All text should be solid off-white.

verificationChecks: Is the display text ultra-condensed and rounded?
Is the subject positioned to the right?
Is the background dark and textured?
Is the color palette restricted to muted tones and white?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the dark background
postGenerationChecks: Check for film grain or analog texture.
Ensure text is left-aligned and stacked.
Verify the stool is a simple wooden design.
Confirm the subject's suit is dark and formal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated portrait on right + Dark textured background + Large condensed rounded text in upper left = Mid-century Soul Aesthetic.
